full_prompt_en: A square storybook illustration shows a round gray forest creature standing beneath a broad orange umbrella against a muted sage-green background. A large flat golden circle sits behind the upper body, framing the pointed ears and making a simple sunny halo. The creature occupies the center from ears to tiny feet near the lower edge. Its upper fur is charcoal gray with a softly fuzzy texture, while its oversized belly is pale cream marked by several curved dark chevrons. Two wide pale eyes stare forward above a small dark nose, and long straight whiskers extend to both sides of the face. One short arm holds the umbrella handle close to the belly; the curved red-orange hook is visible near the left side of the pale fur. The other arm hangs at the right, slightly away from the body. The umbrella canopy spreads across the upper third in golden orange, with fine radial ribs and a darker underside. Its handle drops as a thin vertical line in front of the creature. A narrow grainy shadow under the little feet anchors the figure to an otherwise unmarked ground. The background is a soft green-gray plane with subtle paper texture and generous open space around the central silhouette. Light is broad and warm from the front-left, giving the cream belly a gentle glow and leaving the right fur edge in quiet shadow. The image has crisp outer shapes but slight grain within the fur and umbrella, making its simple geometry feel tactile. No readable text or other objects appear. The overall composition is centered, cheerful, and calm, balancing the large orange canopy and circle against a compact gray-and-cream character.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形童话书插图呈现一只圆滚滚的灰色森林生物，站在宽大橙色雨伞下，背景是暗鼠尾草绿。一个平坦的大金圆落在上半身后，围住尖耳朵，形成简单的阳光般光环。生物从耳朵到下缘附近的小脚占据中央。上半身绒毛呈炭灰色，带柔软毛绒肌理，格外大的肚子是浅奶油色，上面有几道弯曲深色人字形斑纹。两只睁大的浅色眼睛在小黑鼻子上方正面看出，长而直的胡须从脸两侧伸开。一只短臂在肚前握住伞柄；浅色毛腹左侧可见红橙色弯钩。另一只手臂垂在右侧，略离身体。伞面以金橙色铺满上方三分之一，带细密放射伞骨与较暗内侧。伞柄作为一条细竖线从生物身前落下。小脚下方一道狭窄颗粒影子把人物固定在其他部分没有标记的地面上。背景是带微弱纸纹的柔和绿灰平面，中央剪影周围有宽裕开放空间。光从左前方宽广而温暖地照来，让奶油色肚子轻轻发亮，使右侧绒毛边缘保持安静阴影。图像外形清晰，但毛发与伞内有轻微颗粒，使简单几何带可触感。没有可读文字或其他物件。整体构图居中、欢快而平静，以大型橙伞与圆盘平衡紧凑的灰白角色。
style_prompt_en: The storybook illustration simplifies form into a friendly centered silhouette with rounded masses and a few pointed accents. Muted sage green provides wide negative space, while a flat warm circle and orange arc concentrate color behind the central shape. Soft granular texture gives fur-like and paper-like areas a tactile surface without obscuring clean edges. Dark charcoal and pale cream divide the focal volume clearly; small repeated marks add rhythm inside the broad light area. Lighting is gentle and frontal, with only slight shadow under the form and along one side. The composition feels emblematic because large simple shapes align around a stable center, yet fine texture prevents it from becoming a flat icon. The overall effect is warm and whimsical, built from restrained color, soft volume, and readable graphic geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 这种童话书插图把形态简化成友好的居中剪影，包含圆润体量和少量尖形重音。暗鼠尾草绿提供宽广留白，平坦暖圆与橙色弧线将色彩集中于中央形体后方。柔软颗粒肌理让绒毛般与纸般区域带可触表面，却不遮盖干净边缘。深炭灰与浅奶油白明确分开焦点体积；少量重复标记在宽阔亮区内部增添节奏。照明温和而偏正面，只有形体下方和一侧的轻微阴影。大型简单形状围绕稳定中心对齐，使构图带徽章感，细微纹理又避免它成为平板图标。整体效果温暖而奇趣，由克制颜色、柔软体积和易读图形几何构成。
theme_en: A round gray forest creature holding an orange umbrella before a golden circle
theme_zh: 圆滚滚的灰色森林生物举着橙色伞，背后是金色圆盘
name: Totoro
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
